title: Composed supervisory control: Toggle output on qualified rising edge -> Dual-event priority capture with lockout

outputs.name: A_AcceptedPulse
outputs.description: Subsystem A: Qualified edge accepted this scan

outputs.name: B_Captured
outputs.description: Subsystem B: An event has been captured

outputs.name: B_Code
outputs.description: Subsystem B: 0 none, 1 event A, 2 event B

outputs.name: B_Pulse
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Capture occurred this scan

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Reset shall clear A_State and suppress A_AcceptedPulse with highest priority.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A rising A_Button edge while A_Enable is TRUE shall invert A_State exactly once.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: Holding A_Button TRUE shall not repeatedly toggle A_State.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Reset shall clear B_Captured, B_Code, and B_Pulse.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: While armed and not B_Captured, a rising B_EventA shall capture B_Code 1.
requirements.property: G((B_Arm AND !prev(B_Captured) AND rose(B_EventA) AND !B_Reset) -> (B_Captured AND (B_Code = 1) AND B_Pulse))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: A simultaneous rising edge shall select B_EventA over B_EventB.
requirements.property: G((B_Arm AND rose(B_EventA) AND rose(B_EventB) AND !prev(B_Captured) AND !B_Reset) -> (B_Code = 1))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: A rising B_EventB without B_EventA shall capture B_Code 2.
requirements.property: G((B_Arm AND !prev(B_Captured) AND !rose(B_EventA) AND rose(B_EventB) AND !B_Reset) -> (B_Code = 2))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: After capture, later events shall not change B_Code until B_Reset.
A TRUE A_State shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
